footer.tagline: Singapore beyond the stopover: shophouse streets, hawker centres, the old kampong island and the rainforest inside the city.

planner.noJs: This planner works without JavaScript for a 12-hour layover landing at 07:00. Turn JavaScript on to change the inputs.
planner.airsideWhy: Once you subtract immigration, the journey in and out, and the time airlines ask you to be back before departure, there is not enough left for the city to be worth it. Changi is one of the few airports where staying in is a genuinely good option.
planner.jewelWhy: You have just enough time to pass immigration and walk into Jewel, which sits on the public side of Terminal 1. Going further into the city would leave no margin for a delayed train or a queue at security.
planner.cityWhy: There is real time for the city. The plan below keeps to the shade, puts the hottest hours indoors, and leaves a three-hour buffer before your flight.
planner.stayWhy: With this much time you can treat Singapore as a destination: one neighbourhood a day, an early forest walk, and hawker dinners.

rain.ne_wet: Northeast Monsoon, wet phase: longer spells of rain, sometimes all afternoon. Keep the museum and covered-walkway options ready.
rain.ne_dry: Northeast Monsoon, dry phase: often the sunniest, breeziest weeks of the year. Still carry an umbrella.
rain.inter: Inter-monsoon: hot, still mornings and sharp thunderstorms most afternoons, typically 2pm to 6pm. Be under cover by early afternoon.
rain.sw: Southwest Monsoon: generally drier, with occasional squall lines in the pre-dawn and early morning. Hazy days are possible.
